description_en: Query push statistics for an app
name: QueryPushStatByApp

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Specify the time in ISO 8601 format, YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.help_zh: 查询的起始时间，ISO-8601格式，格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. Specify the time in ISO 8601 format, YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.help_zh: 查询的结束时间，ISO-8601格式，格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The data granularity of the response. You can only query data for up to 31 days at daily granularity. Valid values:

DAY: Query data at daily granularity
parameters.help_zh:
返回的数据粒度，目前只支持按天粒度查询 31 内天数据。取值：

DAY：按天粒度查询
parameters.name: granularity

AppPushStat.description_en: An array of AppPushStat objects. The API returns data based on the specified time granularity
AppPushStat.description_zh: APP推送统计AppPushStat组成的数据，根据时间粒度返回数据

AcceptCount.description_en: The number of push notifications accepted by the push server
AcceptCount.description_zh: 推送服务端接收到的推送数目

DeletedCount.description_en: The number of notifications cleared on devices
DeletedCount.description_zh: 通知在设备上被清除的数目

OpenedCount.description_en: The number of notifications clicked on devices
OpenedCount.description_zh: 通知在设备上被点击的数目

ReceivedCount.description_en: The number of notifications actually delivered to devices
ReceivedCount.description_zh: 实际送达到设备的数目

SentCount.description_en: The number of notifications actually sent from the push server
SentCount.description_zh: 推送服务端实际发出的数目

SmsFailedCount.description_en: The number of text messages that failed to send in composite SMS push notifications. Failures may occur due to service unavailability, authorization failure, or invalid parameters. This value can be empty
SmsFailedCount.description_zh: 可为空，短信复合推送短信发送失败的数目，例如未开通对应服务、未授权通过、参数错误等

SmsReceiveFailedCount.description_en: The number of text messages sent but not received on mobile phones in composite SMS push notifications. This value can be empty
SmsReceiveFailedCount.description_zh: 可为空，短信复合推送发出但是手机未收到的短信数目

SmsReceiveSuccessCount.description_en: The number of text messages successfully received in composite SMS push notifications. This value can be empty
SmsReceiveSuccessCount.description_zh: 可为空，短信复合推送成功收到的短信数目

SmsSentCount.description_en: The number of text messages sent in composite SMS push notifications. This value can be empty
SmsSentCount.description_zh: 可为空，短信复合推送发出的短信数目

SmsSkipCount.description_en: The number of text messages skipped in composite SMS push notifications. For example, this occurs when no phone number is bound to the device. This value can be empty
SmsSkipCount.description_zh: 可为空，短信复合推送跳过发送短信的数目，例如未绑手机号
